Title: Arbitrary Patient ID
Description: each sample Id begins with the group (HC, TC or SCI), followed by a number
Comments: that ID is different from the study ID the patients have in TRACK-SCI database. It was created specifically for this study.

Title: Group
Description: the group that the sample belongs, healthy control, trauma control or SCI patient

Title: Sex
Description: sex of patient
Comments: M = male, F = Female

Title: Age at time of Injury
Description: age at the time of the injury in years
Comments: minors were excluded from the study and the maximun age that can be reported for de-identification purposes is 89

Title: Race
Description: race of the subject as reported by themselves
Comments: 1 = Hispanic, 2 = Unknown, 3 = White, 4 = Black, 5 = Other, 6 = Asian

Title: Prior CNS Pathology
Description: all subjects were asked whether they has suffered any CNS pathology in the past

Title: Concurrent TBI
Description: all SCI and trauma subjects were assessed for traumatic brain injury

Title: Injury Severity Score
Description: injury severity score as calculated by clinical staff in the emergency department

Title: Blood draw time
Description: how many hours after the injury was the blood collected
Comments: this is based on the stimated time of injury. In the vast majority of our cases the estimated time of injury is within one hour. However, there are a few cases where the patient was found the next morning and hence the estimated time of injury has a larger range.

Title: Neurological Level of Injury
Description: the level of neurological injury as calculated from the ISNCSCI exam

Title: Neurological Level of Injury grouped
Description: anatomical spical cord injury level (cervical, thoracic, lumbar)

Title: ASIA Impairment Scale
Description: the AIS score as calculated from the ISNCSCI exam

Title: AIS actual or estimate
Description: This variable shows whether the previously reported AIS grade is an actual (ISNCSCI) or a clinician's best estimate
Comments: in the instances where a full ISNCSCI exam was not fully completed the clinicians estimate the AIS grade.

Title: Motor Upper Limb Total - Right + Left
Description: the right and left sum of upper extremities motor scores as assessed by ISNCSCI

Title: Motor Lower Limb Total - Right + Left
Description: the right and left sum of lower extremities motor scores as assessed by ISNCSCI

Title: Sensory Light Touch Total - Right + Left
Description: the right and left sum of touch sensory scores as assessed by ISNCSCI

Title: Sensory Pin Prick Total - Right + Left
Description: the right and left sum of sensory pain scores as assessed by ISNCSCI

Title: Time of exam (days)
Description: the time in days post injury when the ISNCSCI or AIS estimate was performed
Comments: for the purpose of this analysis we used the first available ISNCSCI or AIS estimate between days 3 and 10 post SCI
